title: Forecasting Corn Yield With Machine Learning Ensembles.
summary: Machine-learning ensembles forecast county-level corn yield across three US states and compare held-out time periods against base learners and published yield models; environmental predictors support a limited regional crop-yield forecasting result. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: Weighted ensembles combine ML regressors and environment/management covariates for county-level yield prediction.
